intro.h2: Designers and builders who share one office on Jackson Road
paragraphs: Forward Design Build Remodel has handled kitchen remodeling in Ann Arbor for over 27 years, and its own site calls kitchens its specialty. The same company draws your plans, prices them and builds them, so the designer and the lead carpenter talk every day instead of passing drawings between two firms.

Before you commit to a direction, the team sketches three possible layouts for your home, each at a different price point inside your budget. You pick one, then refine it with material samples and 3D renderings. The site lists typical Ann Arbor kitchen budgets of $100,000 to $250,000, so you know the range before the first meeting.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Ann Arbor, plus baths, whole floors and additions

items.name: Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: Simple redesigns or full rebuilds that remove walls to open a closed-in kitchen to the living area. Each plan starts with your list of priorities, moves through material selections and 3D modeling, and ends with a complete plan the crew can build with confidence.

image.alt: Remodeled Ann Arbor kitchen with white shaker cabinets, dark-base island with four gray stools and exposed ceiling beams

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Primary baths and en-suite bathrooms, from spa-style showers to double vanities. Forward remodels hall baths and powder rooms only as part of a larger project. Its bathroom page lists primary bath remodels at $75,000 to $200,000, depending on the size of the space.

image.alt: Primary bathroom remodel in Ann Arbor with navy walls, white subway tile, dark oak double vanity and black-framed mirrors

items.name: Rekindle Remove-and-Replace
items.blurb: Made for kitchens and baths whose layout already works. Rekindle keeps walls, plumbing and electrical where they are and replaces cabinetry, countertops, tile, flooring, lighting and fixtures. You get interior renderings, a simple scope of work and a budget before work begins.

image.alt: Kitchen update with green full-height cabinets, speckled granite island, black sink and faucet, and wood base cabinets

items.name: Whole-Home and Historic Remodels
items.blurb: When a first floor needs real change, the Reimagine service removes or moves walls, adds rooms and relocates plumbing and electrical. Forward also lists historic home remodeling, and one Google reviewer hired the team to prepare a modest 1956 ranch for aging in place.

image.alt: Historic home kitchen remodel with walnut lower cabinets, open wood shelving, white counters and a stainless refrigerator

items.name: Additions and Custom Homes
items.blurb: Home additions and new custom homes follow the same design-build steps, from concept layouts through a final inspection walk-through. The portfolio includes a dog-friendly custom farmhouse design in Ann Arbor with a covered wood porch and an open, airy layout.

image.alt: Home addition in Ann Arbor with a covered wood porch, board-and-batten siding and an orange front door

why_choose_us.h2: What sets Forward apart before, during and after the build

items.title: Three concepts, three price points
items.text: Step one ends with floor plans of your existing home and three sketched layouts, each at a different price point within your budget, plus a written evaluation of scope, time and cost.

items.title: Award-winning kitchens and baths
items.text: NARI named Forward a Regional Contractor of the Year for a mid-century modern kitchen in 2022 and for its Modern Barn Bath in 2023. The firm also lists 14 Houzz awards and a Guildmaster award.

items.title: A place to stay during construction
items.text: Clients can rent Terra Knoll, the firm's furnished home on Ann Arbor's west side, while their own house is torn up. The site lists it at $3,500 a month with utilities included.

items.title: A written warranty and a service team
items.text: Your warranty period starts when construction is complete, and you get it in writing. Forward keeps a warranty manager on staff and a Home Care and Repair team for small fixes and finish updates.

about.text: Jef Forward started the company more than 27 years ago with a passion for both architecture and building, and chose design-build as the way he wanted to serve homeowners. He still leads it as President and Creative Director, and was a runner-up for the Fred Case Remodeling Entrepreneur of the Year award in 2019. Forward keeps designers, project consultants, carpenters, a warranty manager and a service team in-house at 8110 Jackson Rd., where clients can visit the showroom by appointment. Every build gets its own Project Manager, Project Designer and Project Coordinator, who meet with you on a regular schedule until the final walk-through.

image.alt: Jef Forward, President and Creative Director, meeting on a job site with lead carpenter Jeff

process.h2: How the Forward design-build process works

steps.title: Clarify your vision
steps.text: After you sign a design agreement, the team reviews your goals, researches your home and local codes, and sketches three layouts at three price points.

steps.title: Shape the design
steps.text: Materials, colors and fixtures are chosen, drawings grow into 3D renderings, and the scope and budget are updated so you can see what drives the cost.

steps.title: Confirm and build
steps.text: A pre-construction meeting sets communication and dust control rules. Your Project Manager meets with you regularly, and the crew leaves the work area clean.

steps.title: Walk-through and warranty
steps.text: A final inspection walk-through checks every detail. Your written warranty period begins as soon as construction is complete.

service_area.h2: Remodeling in Ann Arbor and nearby Michigan towns
service_area.text: Forward works out of its office and showroom at 8110 Jackson Rd. on the west side of Ann Arbor. The contact page and site footer name Ann Arbor, Dexter, Pinckney, Plymouth, Saline, Chelsea and Scio as service areas. Past projects include a farmhouse kitchen in Dexter and a classic kitchen redesign in Plymouth. If your town is not on the list, the team asks you to reach out and check.

faq.h2: Ann Arbor kitchen and bath questions, answered

items.q: What does a kitchen remodel cost in Ann Arbor?
items.a: Forward's kitchen page lists typical custom kitchen remodels in Ann Arbor at $100,000 to $250,000. Your number depends on size, finishes and whether walls or plumbing move. The first design step shows three concept layouts at three price points inside your budget, so you can compare before you commit.

items.q: Will you remodel just a powder room or hall bath?
items.a: Not on its own. Forward does not take on single hallway bath or powder room remodels, but it will remodel those rooms as part of a larger project. A primary bathroom remodel runs $75,000 to $200,000 depending on the size of the space, not counting a walk-in closet.

items.q: My kitchen layout works. Do I need a full redesign?
items.a: Maybe not. The Rekindle service is for kitchens, baths and interiors where no walls, plumbing or electrical locations move. The team picks fixtures and materials with you, shows interior renderings, and sets a simple scope and budget. Projects that move walls or add rooms go through the Reimagine service.

items.q: Where can we live while the work is going on?
items.a: Forward clients can book Terra Knoll, a furnished rental home on the west side of Ann Arbor, about 5 miles from downtown Ann Arbor and 4 miles from downtown Dexter. The site lists the rent at $3,500 a month including utilities, and the team walks you through booking it before construction starts.

Yes. Forward provides a written warranty that outlines its activities over the warranty period, which starts once construction is complete. The firm has a warranty manager on staff, and its Home Care and Repair team helps clients with small projects, from simple repairs to replacing finishes.

final_cta.h2: Tell Forward what your kitchen needs
final_cta.text: Call (734) 761-8403, Monday to Friday, 8:30 am to 5:00 pm, or send the consultation form and the team will get back to you.
